# ZIP File

## Summary
The FileDef specialization for ZIP archives.
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `FileDef`. The richest of the archive defs. Adds `archiveContents` (`containsMany(ArchiveEntryField)`),
`uncompressedSize`, `compressedSize` and `truncatedListing`, filled by reading the
central directory rather than inflating the payload. `truncatedListing` is
load-bearing: a large archive is listed up to a budget, and the flag records
that the listing is partial rather than letting a consumer read it as complete.

Accepts: `.zip, application/zip`

## Example
```ts
import { ZipDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/zip-file-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(ZipDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
